messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created: GPU_POOL_STARVE_APAC (P1) - hosted-api queue growing rapidly in apac-edge. Pager duty notified.

Priya (oncall): seeing huge queue growth in apac, p95 spiking, can someone confirm numbers?

Liam (infra): confirmed. queue depth ~18k requests across apac shards, sustained 90s enqueue->dequeue. p95 ~11.8s, p99 ~46.2s, error rate 5xx up from 0.3% -> 6.7%.

Sara (sre): what triggered it? any deploys?

Liam (infra): no recent infra deploys. Traffic pattern looks like a burst from a partner fanout — traffic from apac-region-lb-3 to hosted-api apac hash-shard.

Priya (oncall): assigning runbook. immediate steps: 1) increase autoscale limits for apac GPU pool 2) enable cross-region fallback routing to us-east for small customers 3) apply emergency rate limit for RTU clients.

Kevin (ml-runtime): autoscaler is hitting the soft max nodes (configured at 40 gpus). Provisioner is returning quota errors on new instances from cloud provider. logs: ```provisioner: allocate: failed: QuotaExceeded: requested 8 GPUs, limit 40```

Priya (oncall): can we bump pool limit manually while ops engages cloud quota?

Liam (infra): I can temporarily raise the pool's max to 80, but it will take ~3m to create nodes if cloud approves. kicking it now.

ops-bot: Action queued: increase-dedicated-pool apac-hosted max=80 by liam. ETA: 180s.

Maya (customer-success): flagging customers: acme-inc and travellytics seeing 504s. CS has triaged and is preparing comms.

Sara (sre): meanwhile, enable fallback routing policy to route requests over 20s queue time to US region. Priya, can we flip the policy?

Priya (oncall): flipping fallback policy: set routedown-threshold=20s, target-region=us-east, apply to tier=free,standard.

ops-bot: Policy update applied: fallback-routing (apac->us-east) enabled.

Kevin (ml-runtime): enabling prefix/KV cache reuse across fallback variants to preserve latency on rerouted requests. Deploying config: ```runtime.config.kv_cache.shared=true```

Liam (infra): cloud still returning soft quota errors but nodes are booting a few at a time. provisioning logs: ```instance-3 ready, instance-4 pending, instance-5 error QuotaExceeded```

Priya (oncall): start a temporary ingress token bucket: limit 60 rps per tenant for non-enterprise to blunt the burst. We want to protect latency for paying customers.

Sara (sre): applied token-bucket: ```/hosted-api: rate-limit: tenant.non-enterprise: 60rps``` - monitoring p95 for enterprise vs non-enterprise.

Liam (infra): after fallback and rate-limits, observed queue drop from 18k -> 6.2k in 8 minutes. p95 reduced to ~6.1s, p99 ~18s. error rate down to 2.1%.

Maya (customer-success): CS will send targeted note to top 20 customers affected. Estimated impacted customers: ~120 distinct tenants, ~7 major enterprise customers limited. No revenue-impacting customers currently reports critical outages yet.

Priya (oncall): paging rotation: I'm on until 03:00 UTC. After that handoff to Sara. @Sara please prepare oncall notes and confirm whether to keep fallback on.

Sara (sre): will take at 03:00 UTC. suggest keeping fallback and token bucket until autoscaler stable for 30m with queue <1000.

Kevin (ml-runtime): quick perf note — many of the requests were long-context generation (seq_len 2048) from a single partner. recommend quantization profile bump and temporary model replica with lower mem footprint to fit more concurrent streams per GPU. spinning up a q4_0 replica.

Liam (infra): provisioner now reports 28/80 gpus allocated in apac. Quota request approved partially; cloud support engaged for remaining quota.

Priya (oncall): runbook checklist update: increased pool cap, enabled fallback routing, applied token-bucket, spun up quantized replica, notified CS. Next: monitor for 30m, then scale down config.

ops-bot: Incident update: GPU_POOL_STARVE_APAC - mitigations applied. Current severity: P1 -> P2 candidate if metrics hold.

Maya (customer-success): draft comms ready: short incident note + ETA for full recovery ~2h. Will coordinate on customer-facing timeline.

Sara (sre): after 22 minutes post-mitigation p95 ~2.8s, queue depth 980. p99 ~6.9s. Moving to monitoring.

Priya (oncall): handing over to @Sara for overnight. I'm leaving notes in the runbook and PagerDuty. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Handoff logged: from=Priya to=Sara at=1765403923.

Sara (sre): taking over. I'll keep fallback and token bucket active; will start scale-down plan once queue <500 and stable for 20m. Final note: follow up with infra to request permanent quota increase for apac pool and add a protection rule for sudden partner fanouts (circuit-breaker).

Kevin (ml-runtime): opened PR to add auto-quantized fallback model path and recommended config: ```runtime.fallback.quantize=true``` - link: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/3821

Liam (infra): filing cloud quota request ticket and escalation: https://cloud.support/tickets/78921 - ETA 6-12h for full quota.

Maya (customer-success): CS will post initial notice in customer status page and follow up with affected customers this hour.

Priya (oncall): closing the live ops bridge. Incident will remain open for postmortem. Please add any logs/screenshots to the incident doc.

ops-bot: Incident GPU_POOL_STARVE_APAC marked: mitigated (P1->P2) at=1765403923 by=Priya. Postmortem assigned to: sara, liam, kevin.
